Name: Mered
Summary: Son of Ezra, who took Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:17: Son of Ezra, who took Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Mered stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
